json.text: Supposedly this charm will ward off spells cast by witches, yet all the witches I have met only
ever throw potions at me.  I am not entirely convinced if this thing is useful!
This amulet grants the wearer immunity to the effects of a potion.
This pouch can be used to stack potions of the same type, allowing the wearer to carry more potions.
By default it can hold 16 potions of the same type in a single stack, but I also might be able
to apply patches from my practitioner's pouch for more!  Depth, Speed, Conveyance, and Collection
all seem like they would have some value.
This eye is said to allow the wearer to identify the alchemical properties of items in the world.
(This item only works if the
Mystic Alchemy
mod is installed.)
The Witch's Cauldron is a specialized crucible enhanced with silver and arcane energies. What sets it apart from ordinary crucibles is its ability to collect moonlight directly from the night sky.

When empty and placed under open sky, the cauldron will gradually fill with condensed moonlight during the night hours. This captured moonlight glows with a gentle radiance and serves as a potent brewing medium superior to water.

I can bottle this moonlight for later use, or transfer it between cauldrons using buckets. The cauldron functions as an enhanced crucible for all alchemical purposes, making it invaluable for advanced potion brewing.
Some mages choose to remain factionless, preferring to live in the wilds and avoid the politics
of the faction war.  They are often seen as outcasts, but they are also free to practice their
magic as they see fit.
Factionless mages are often seen as dangerous, as they are not bound by the laws of the factions.
They have learned some form of sympathetic magic which allows them to cast spells over great
distances, but supposedly their magic is severely curtailed, yet I'm not sure how.
I have heard that these mages prefer to be referred to as
Hedge Witches
.  This makes me wonder whether they have learned some of their secrets from the wild witches I
have encountered in the swamps.  Perhaps if I can observe a witch in secret I will learn more.
There are also rumors that some of these factionless mages have forsworn their neutrality and
angered all of the factions.  Woe to these
Spite Witches
, for they are hunted by all.
This enchantment is only available to members of the
Coven
, and it brings out the natural magic in their
wands, staves, and bangles
, rather than relying on their own essence.
Dedicated items can be recharged in a crucible overflowing with instant mana or mana regeneration.
This ritual cannot protect me from sympathetic magic, but it will destroy any items that are
used against me.  I must have a player charm bound to myself.
This ritual allows me to use a sympathetic link to a a player or mob to apply my magic over
great distances. I must have a poppet bound to my target, as well as a player charm bound to myself.
This ritual calls upon a witch to induct worthy practitioners into the
Coven of Hedge Witches

.

Those who have demonstrated mastery of their current magical tier and completed the required spell demonstrations may undergo this ceremony.

The witch will appear to judge your worthiness. If you have proven yourself through both magical advancement and spell mastery, she will welcome you into the Coven and share the secrets of the next tier of magic.
Allying oneself with the Coven of Hedge Witches binds your mana regeneration and declares your neutrality in the faction war.

At last, I can craft my own flying broom! The ritual requires binding moonlight into the bristles and transmuted silver into the handle. Once enchanted, the broom should respond to its rider's will, carrying them through the skies.

I must remember to be cautious when flying in the Nether. The intense heat seems to interfere with the broom's enchantments, and I've heard tales of witches who found their brooms suddenly failing them above lakes of lava. Perhaps with stronger enchantments this limitation could be overcome, but for now I shall keep my flights there brief and close to solid ground.
The ancient
Coven
has long practiced arts that blur the lines between alchemy and witchcraft. Their greatest creation is the
Moonthread Armor

, woven from enchanted silk under the full moon's light.

This mystical armor is as protective as the finest chain armor, providing exceptional defense against physical harm. When wearing this armor, I find that
beneficial potion effects last twice as long

, allowing me to make the most of my alchemical preparations.

The armor also
nullifies harmful magical effects

that would otherwise afflict me, though this protection requires time to recharge between uses. Each nullification damages the armor slightly, so I must maintain it carefully.

Perhaps most remarkably, the armor's protective aura
prevents hostile creatures from spawning nearby
, creating a sanctuary wherever I rest.
